scenario: `{p.body.x:+}` on a String leaf. A sign is refused on a String (LGRA.2.9.6.5), so at run time it is a TypeError (LGRA.2.9.6.11) and `handler` logs. PATH PINNED: the sign-or-zero check in the interpolation renderer (libds `render_value`, Mercury `ds.format.render_value`). A renderer that ignores the sign logs `v ab`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "v {p.body.x:+}"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
